ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: How fast the day passes and how the weather changes, the same for everyone.
ADMIN_C_TIME_DESC: The in-game clock every player sees.
ADMIN_H_SCALE: Game minutes per real minute: 2 makes a game day last 12 real hours, 30 is GTA Online's 48 minutes.
ADMIN_H_START_HOUR: The clock starts at this hour when the server starts.
ADMIN_H_FREEZE: Time stands still at the current hour.
ADMIN_C_WEATHER_DESC: The weather changes by itself through the list, or stays.
ADMIN_H_DYNAMIC: Off: the first weather of the list stays.
ADMIN_H_WEATHERS: GTA weather names in the order they follow (EXTRASUNNY, CLEAR, CLOUDS, OVERCAST, RAIN, THUNDER, CLEARING, FOGGY, SMOG, SNOW, XMAS...).
ADMIN_H_BLACKOUT: City lights go out (vehicles keep their lights).
